card.name: Inside tonsillitis and similar words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a word split into parts, mostly the 'il' or 'ill' in tonsillitis and tonsillectomy. It also fires on similar splits in words like Lampsilis and babysitters.

modes.label: Tonsil words
modes.description: The 'il' or 'ill' piece inside tonsillitis or tonsillectomy in dosing and indication text.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle pieces of rare words such as a mussel genus name or babysitters.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the word tonsillitis when the word is split into pieces, and sometimes in other rare words.
